text:
Maya: FYI incoming customer bug (ticket #5821). They called the API to get an estimate and the model routed to the charge.create tool which actually initiated a charge. Customer panicked. Need triage.

Maya: snippets from the agent request/response we logged:

Request (from customer):
```
POST /v1/generate
{\n  "input": "How much would it cost to charge $120 to card ending 4242?",\n  "tools": ["charge.create","charge.estimate","billing.lookup"]\n}
```

Model response (truncated):
```
{"tool_call": {"name": "charge.create", "args": {"amount": 120, "card_last4": "4242"}}}
```

Maya: We have a follow-up log showing the tool was executed by the resolver and returned a success 200 for a created charge. Customer account was refunded immediately but this is a major support escalation.

Jun: Ouch. Can you paste the resolver decision log? specifically the matching score/intent metadata?

Maya: paste of resolver snippet:```
resolver_match: {"tool": "charge.create", "score": 0.62, "reason": "verb match: 'charge'", "ambiguity": true}
```

Maya: Looks like the resolver used a fuzzy verb match on 'charge' and didn't pick up 'estimate' intent.

Logan: Two quick likely causes: 1) tool aliases overlap (both have alias 'charge'), 2) tool schema for estimate and create share similar args (amount, card_last4) so schema-based disambiguation didn't rule it out.

Jun: Agreed. On top of that our fallback policy is to choose highest scoring tool instead of asking clarifying question when score > 0.5. This was a bad opt for billing-affecting tools.

Priya: Suggest adding a safety rule: if any candidate tool is side-effecting (create/modify), require either explicit 'intent: confirm' in UI/prompt or a stronger threshold (e.g., score > 0.85) to execute. Non-side-effecting tools (estimate/lookup) can be lower.

Jun: That's a good policy. Quick triage plan:
- Ramp down: add runtime guard to block any tool with tag "side_effect" in prod resolver until we have safe thresholds. (temporary)
- Repro: write a minimal prompt that reproduces misroute and add to regression tests.
- Long term: resolver improvements (alias weighting, intent detection, explicit disambiguation).

Logan: For repro, try the exact prompt above with model = "redwood-model-v3" and tool set ordering randomized. If we see consistent create selection we can blame the intent scoring defender.

Maya: I reproduced locally with the sample. Model v3 chooses charge.create ~60% of runs, charge.estimate ~30%, ambiguous ~10%.

opsbot: CI job queued: #ci/patch/resolve-side-effect-guard (Jun) -> https://ci.internal/patches/3872

Jun: I'll push a hotfix to the resolver to require score >= 0.85 for tools tagged "side_effect" and to log a clarifying prompt to the client when blocked. Deploying to staging now.

Priya: Add a unit/regression: prompt containing keywords ["estimate","how much","cost","quote"] should bias toward any tool with verb "estimate". Also add e2e test to ensure resolver asks confirmation for side-effecting tools.

Maya: I'll handle customer comms: explain we paused any accidental charges and applied a refund, and that we're pushing a safety guard.

Logan: Also recommend we audit tool names/aliases in billing domain: standardize to "billing.estimate" and "billing.create_charge" (avoid shared token 'charge').

Jun: Agreed. I'll include alias rename in follow-up task but we need the hotfix first.

Priya: Assigning follow-ups: Jun -> hotfix + staging deploy; Logan -> alias audit; Maya -> customer comms + ticket update; Priya -> tests + regression.

Maya: Noted. Will update ticket and confirm refund and timeline.

Jun: Hotfix deployed to staging, running smoke tests. If green, will promote to prod during low-traffic window.

Maya: Thanks. Please ping me before prod promote so I can update the customer timeline. :thumbsup:

Logan: Also adding an analytics check to surface any tool_call that executed a side-effecting tool when user language contained 'estimate' or 'how much' last 30 days. Want to know if we've had other near-misses.

Maya: Closing loop: ticket updated with incident summary and ETA for prod fix 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. I'll follow up after prod promote.

Jun: PR: https://git.internal/r/resolver/patches/467 (adds side_effect threshold + logging).

opsbot: Deploy pipeline started for canary -> https://deploys.internal/redwood/resolver/canary/1792001240

Priya: Nice. After this we should add a policy doc in docs/ops about "side_effect" tool handling and recommended name conventions for tools (no shared verbs).

Maya: Thanks all. Will mark ticket high and keep thread updated.
